verdict.rationale: Convex documents itself as a reactive database with real-time sync. It moves data between client and server over WebSockets and pushes changes to clients for live updates, so the UI updates without client polling. Community commenters confirm that the whole query function is the unit of reactivity and is rerun when a mutation overlaps its read set. One commenter asked whether this is 'smart polling', but that is a question, not a contradiction. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs for the client subscription API (e.g. the hook or subscribe call and its semantics), and hands-on corroboration of update latency or behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can subscribe to live data changes so my UI updates in real time without polling

citations.quote: moving data between the client and server on WebSockets, state management on the client, and pushing changes for live updates.
Real-time sync so your users instantly see the latest data
It makes it easy to build and scale dynamic live-updating apps.
Convex is the open source, reactive database where queries are TypeScript code running right in the database.
